lessons.title: Practice MAE
lessons.description: Implement mae(y_true, y_pred) returning the mean of the absolute differences (mean absolute error). The test checks mae([1, 3], [2, 3]) == 0.5.
learning_objectives: Using errors and 3, this step averages the absolute errors.
lessons.solution_code:
def mae(y_true, y_pred):
    return sum(abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(y_true, y_pred)) / len(y_true)
